eeca4d97f8864963.description: About the Role: Group Data Protection Officer Tamer Services Company is partnering with a leading holding company in Jeddah, Makkah, to appoint a Group Data Protection Officer (DPO). This full-time, strategic leadership role is responsible for establishing and overseeing the Group's enterprise-wide data privacy and protection framework. The successful candidate will ensure compliance with the KSA Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and serve as the Group's primary privacy advisor, driving governance and a strong data protection culture across the organization. Key Responsibilities Lead the implementation and continuous monitoring of the Group's data privacy framework in alignment with the KSA PDPL. Act as the primary point of contact with SDAIA, coordinating regulatory communications and compliance initiatives. Oversee Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs), and Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs). Advise business and technology teams on Privacy by Design principles and privacy risk management. Coordinate personal data breach response activities and regulatory notifications as required. Drive consistency across subsidiary DPOs and strengthen enterprise-wide privacy governance. Promote a culture of data privacy through awareness, training, and engagement initiatives. Provide regular reporting and strategic recommendations to senior leadership on privacy risks and compliance. Qualifications and Experience 8+ years of experience in data protection, privacy, legal, compliance, or risk management. Hands-on expertise in the KSA PDPL, its Implementing Regulations, and SDAIA/NDMO requirements. Strong knowledge of privacy operations, including RoPA, DPIAs, breach management, Data Subject Rights, and cross-border data transfers. Familiarity with international privacy and security frameworks such as GDPR and ISO 27001. Experience operating within a multi-entity or holding company environment is highly preferred. Bachelor's degree in Law, Information Governance, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related discipline. A recognized privacy certification is considered an advantage. Fluency in both Arabic and English. Required Skills Ability to influence senior stakeholders across a complex group structure. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Strong regulatory expertise combined with practical application. Work Environment This role operates within a leading holding company structure, requiring collaboration across various subsidiaries and engagement with senior leadership. The position is based in Jeddah, Makkah.

eed62bf8dee2e2de.description: Job Summary CCTV Room Operator is responsible for supporting the implementation and day-to-day operation of security surveillance systems within the workplace. The role focuses on ensuring that guests, employees, contractors, and company assets are protected from potential security threats through continuous monitoring and timely reporting. The CCTV Room Operator’s duties include monitoring CCTV systems, access control systems, and alarm systems, ensuring compliance with security procedures, identifying suspicious activities, and reporting risks or incidents in accordance with company policies. The role also involves assisting with emergency response, maintaining accurate records, and supporting overall security operations under the direction of Security Management. Essential Duties and Responsibilities • Evaluation of all monitored activities with a view to assessing potential risks and security threats. • Ensure compliance with company security standards and procedures at all times. • Continuous monitoring of CCTV cameras, access control systems, and alarm systems. • Identify suspicious behavior, safety hazards, or security breaches and report immediately. • Recording all incidents, observations, and actions taken in the occurrence log system. • Review CCTV footage during investigations and provide accurate evidence when required. • Communicate and coordinate with all relevant stakeholders (security teams, emergency services, management, and departments) in alignment with emergency response situations to ensure timely effective action. • Assist during emergencies by providing real-time information from surveillance systems. • Ensure all surveillance equipment is functioning properly and report faults or malfunctions. • Maintain strict confidentiality of all security systems, footage, and operational information. • Provide solutions and recommendations to improve monitoring effectiveness. • Work diligently to maintain a safe and secure environment at all times. • Follow up on incidents and ensure proper documentation is completed. • Support preparation of reports, statistics, and security records. • Ensure safe and proper use of all monitoring equipment. Standard Responsibilities Monitor daily security operations through CCTV systems to ensure safety of guests, employees, visitors, and property at all times Enforce security policies, procedures, and standards in line with company requirements Monitor CCTV, fire alarm systems, access control systems, and other security technologies Ensure all monitoring systems are operational and any faults are reported immediately Comply and adhere to company policies at all times Take on additional tasks within a reasonable framework as required. Model the company’s culture, vision, mission, and core values at all times. Maintain effective communication with other departments to ensure smooth operations Respond to incidents efficiently and professionally Consistently meet expectations of internal and external stakeholders. Confidentiality Whilst working for the company there will be access to a wide variety of confidential information concerning the company, guests, and employees. It is vital that all such information remains confidential and must not be disclosed to anyone outside the organization unless authorized. Health & Safety Be aware of and comply with safe working practices as laid down under Health and Safet regulations. Report any defects in systems, equipment, or facilities according to procedure. Ensure that any incidents or accidents are reported immediately and correctly. Attend required Fire, Health & Safety training and comply with all procedures. Be fully conversant with emergency procedures including fire, evacuation, and security threats. Maintain a safe working environment within the CCTV control room. Other The above description is not to be regarded as exhaustive; additional duties may be assigned as required Flexibility in working hours, including shifts, weekends, and holidays, is required Job description will be reviewed periodically to reflect operational needs.

eecf93f9aaf6f855.description: About the Role Tuwaiq Casting & Forging Company is seeking an EAF Engineer to join the Melting Shop Department within the Production Division. This full-time position is based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region, and reports directly to the Melting Shop Manager. The role is critical for the operation and management of the Electric Arc Furnace (EAF) in manufacturing processes. Key Responsibilities Prepare and maintain Electric Arc Furnace work specifications based on material standards, manufacturing specifications, and approved melting procedures. Plan and manage raw materials, scrap, alloying elements, fluxes, consumables, electrodes, and tools required for EAF operations in accordance with the production schedule. Monitor and control EAF operating parameters including charging practices, power input, arc stability, oxygen and carbon injection, slag practice, melting temperature, tapping conditions, and melt chemistry to achieve specified metallurgical requirements. Coordinate with the Maintenance Department to ensure preventive maintenance, inspection, calibration, and timely repair of EAF equipment, transformers, electrode systems, cooling systems, and auxiliary equipment. Optimise furnace performance by improving melting efficiency, reducing power consumption, minimising electrode and refractory consumption, maximising metal yield, and reducing tap-to-tap time. Ensure compliance with API Spec Q1, API 20A, API 20B, ISO 9001:2015, and applicable customer quality requirements related to melting operations and process control. Monitor electricity consumption, electrode usage, raw material consumption, and other production costs to improve operational efficiency. Investigate process abnormalities, analyse melting defects, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Maintain accurate production records and analyse operational performance using ERP and MES systems to improve productivity, reduce waste, enhance traceability, and support continuous improvement. Coordinate with Production, Quality, Raw Material, Refractory, and Maintenance teams to ensure uninterrupted and efficient EAF operations. Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and housekeeping requirements throughout EAF operations. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in EAF operations or a similar industrial melting environment. Specific educational requirements were not provided, but a strong technical background is expected for this role.

ee475ad406defc22.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة محمود عمران بسموق للمقاولات عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام داخل أماكن العمل، من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل لمراقبة الممتلكات ضد السرقة والتخريب. مراقبة منافذ الدخول والخروج من المنشأة وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة. التحقق من هويات الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. تفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان إغلاقها وتأمينها بشكل صحيح. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث المبلغ عنها. التواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة العليا بالحوادث. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الأمن أو ما شابه. القدرة على مراقبة الأوضاع الأمنية والاستجابة بفعالية للحوادث. الالتزام بالتعليمات والسياسات والإجراءات الأمنية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل حارس الأمن ضمن فريق مخصص لضمان سلامة وأمن منشآت الشركة وموظفيها وزوارها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

ee071a38b542e569.description: About the Role Albawani is seeking a Design Manager (Structural) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is accountable for the delivery, quality, coordination, and constructability of all structural design outputs within Design & Build projects. The Design Manager ensures that structural design solutions meet contractual, technical, statutory, programme, and construction requirements for permanent works. Key Responsibilities Own and control structural design development across all project stages, ensuring compliance with Employer’s Requirements, contract documents, codes, and standards. Approve and be accountable for all structural design drawings, calculations, shop drawings, and technical submissions prior to issue or construction release. Direct Technical Coordinators and discipline engineers to resolve structural design clashes, omissions, constructability issues, and interface risks. Ensure structural design is fully coordinated with architectural, MEPF, geotechnical, utilities, and temporary works requirements. Plan, manage, and drive the structural design programme to meet project milestones, procurement needs, and construction priorities. Establish and enforce structural design QA/QC requirements, including discipline reviews, coordination checks, and approval protocols. Act as the single point of technical authority for all structural design matters within the project. Identify opportunities for structural optimization, value engineering, and construction efficiency improvements. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of proven experience leading structural design teams and managing Technical Coordinators. Strong knowledge of structural design codes, standards, and authority approval processes relevant to the project location. Demonstrated experience managing design risk, constructability, and site-driven design changes. Experience in Design & Build construction projects requiring discipline-led structural design management. Experience with large-scale, multidisciplinary developments with complex construction and authority requirements. Technical Skills Strong capability in structural design leadership, technical governance, and approval of complex structural systems within a Design & Build environment. Demonstrated understanding of progressive collapse design principles and their application to robustness and risk mitigation strategies. Working knowledge of blast analysis and protective structural design, sufficient to review, challenge, and approve specialist analysis and recommendations. Proficiency in the review and governance of structural analysis and design models prepared using industry-standard software (*, SAP2000, ETABS, SAFE, or equivalent). Ability to review and validate structural calculations, modelling assumptions, and design outputs produced by consultants and specialist designers. Strong understanding of construction-driven structural design and contractor-led Design & Build delivery models. Experience with façade structural systems and interfaces is preferred. Sound engineering judgment and decision-making capability under programme, construction, and risk constraints. Clear leadership and communication skills to direct Technical Coordinators and discipline inputs and to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and authorities. Work Environment The role is based in a site office environment, with a low to medium physical risk degree. The Design Manager will interact with internal teams including the Technical Director, other Design Managers, Technical Coordinators, Construction/Operations, Procurement & Commercial, Planning/Project Controls, and QA/QC teams. External contacts include Lead Design Consultants, Specialist Structural Subcontractors, Vendors/Suppliers, Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), and Client/PMC Representatives.

Deliver effective disposal of closed and surplus stores in line with market conditions.
